literal: Kin resembling, kin those-who-are-not friendship, women mind like different will-become.
translation: The friendship of those who look like your own kind but are not will change, just like the minds of fickle women.
modern: தமக்கு நெருக்கமானவர்களைப் போல நடித்து உண்மையில் அன்பில்லாதவர்களின் நட்பு, நிலையற்ற மனமுடைய மகளிரின் மனம்போல அடிக்கடி மாறிக்கொண்டே இருக்கும்.
explanation: This couplet warns against false friends who pretend to be part of one's inner circle. The word 'இனம்' (inam) means one's own kind or kin, representing true, loyal friends. Those who only resemble true friends but are not will not remain loyal. Their friendship is compared to the minds of 'மகளிர்' (makaḷir, women)—which in this specific context implies women whose affections are fickle and transactional. Just as their minds constantly shift, the loyalty of false friends will change when it suits them.
